## Table A. Main result (E8): unseen layouts, 3 independent runs (mean ± std), 95% bootstrap CI

### Clean text (n = 240 documents)
| Extractor | Field accuracy | 95% CI | Fully correct invoices | ms/invoice (CPU) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Regex rules | 28.1 ± 0.9% | 24.6–31.8% | 0.0% | 0.94 |
| Layout heuristic | 44.9 ± 3.2% | 42.4–47.2% | 0.0% | 1.15 |
| Rules ensemble | 39.7 ± 1.8% | 35.9–43.6% | 0.0% | 2.76 |
| Linear model (ablation: no sequence modelling) | 97.9 ± 1.7% | 96.6–99.0% | 78.3% | 9.31 |
| **LayoutKIE-CRF (ours)** | 99.6 ± 0.6% | 98.9–99.9% | 95.4% | 12.12 |

McNemar (fully-correct invoices), CRF vs linear model: p = 0.0000; all rule baselines vs either model: p < 0.001.
